name: ALERTWest
description: Ingests ALERTWest wildfire camera locations, orientation and latest imagery from the ALERTWest SAPI and posts each camera to the map or registers it as a Core Device.

permissions.description: ALERTWest posts camera locations to the map
ALERTWest creates and updates a Core Device for each camera mapped to a Core Device by the Layer's camera Mapping

schedule.description: Polls the ALERTWest SAPI for the full camera list on a schedule - defaults to every 5 minutes.
